script.name: Set executable permissions
script.description: Makes the server binary executable before every start.
script.code:
#!/bin/sh
# The Steam depot does not carry the execute bit (and a file-manager upload never does), so make sure
# the server binary, its crash handler and the helper script are executable before every start. Idempotent.
cd "${ThisService_RootDirectory}" || exit 0
chmod +x Engine/Binaries/Linux/FactoryServer-Linux-Shipping 2>/dev/null
chmod +x Engine/Binaries/Linux/crashpad_handler 2>/dev/null
chmod +x FactoryServer.sh 2>/dev/null
exit 0

script.name: Link save folder into the service root
script.description: Points the service user's ~/.config/Epic/FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames at FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames in the service root, so saves are in the file manager and backups.
script.code:
#!/bin/sh
# Satisfactory's Linux server saves to $HOME/.config/Epic/FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames. TCAdmin starts the
# server with HOME set to the service root, so the saves land in <root>/.config/Epic/FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames.
# Turn that folder into a symlink to the service root's FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames so the saves show up in
# the file manager and in backups. Runs as the service user before every start, so nothing runs with
# elevated rights. A run before the first start just creates the link up front.
ROOT="${ThisService_RootDirectory}"
[ -n "$ROOT" ] && [ -d "$ROOT" ] || exit 0
DST="$ROOT/FactoryGame/Saved/SaveGames"
SAVEPARENT="$ROOT/.config/Epic/FactoryGame/Saved"
SRC="$SAVEPARENT/SaveGames"
mkdir -p "$DST" || exit 1

# A link from an earlier start: removing it never touches its target.
if [ -L "$SRC" ]; then
  [ "$(readlink -f "$SRC")" = "$(readlink -f "$DST")" ] && exit 0
  rm -f "$SRC"
fi

# Saves written before the link existed move into the service root. Nothing is overwritten: leftovers
# that clash with an existing file are set aside next to the link.
if [ -d "$SRC" ]; then
  ( cd "$SRC" && find . -type f | while IFS= read -r f; do
      f="${f#./}"
      target="$DST/$f"
      [ -e "$target" ] && continue
      mkdir -p "$(dirname "$target")" && mv "$SRC/$f" "$target"
    done )
  find "$SRC" -depth -type d -empty -delete 2>/dev/null
  [ -d "$SRC" ] && mv "$SRC" "$SAVEPARENT/SaveGames.unmerged.$$"
fi

mkdir -p "$SAVEPARENT" || exit 1
ln -s "$DST" "$SRC"
exit 0
